usage.callShape: GET https://2s.io/api/crypto/address-validate?chain={chain}&address={address} (required query params; chain enum: btc|eth|sol|ltc|trx|xrp|bch)
usage.outputShape: body.data.items[0].valid (boolean), body.data.items[0].canonical (normalized address), body.data.items[0].format (e.g. eip-55), body.data.items[0].reason (null if valid); body.data.ok and body.data.total summarize the batch
usage.guide: Call GET https://2s.io/api/crypto/address-validate with two required query params: chain (one of btc, eth, sol, ltc, trx, xrp, bch) and address (the wallet address string). Payment is x402 USDC ($0.001) on Base or Solana; no API key. Read the result from body.data.items[0]: valid tells you if the address is well-formed for that chain, canonical gives the normalized address, format names the encoding, and reason explains failures when valid is false.
